summary: Practise team agreements, Kanban flow and Agile improvement routines. Explore the five-day foundation course and plan your next step.
lede: Agile team leadership helps team leads, delivery coordinators and aspiring practitioners guide collaboration and address delivery blockers. Through practical exercises, they learn to set team agreements and decision policies, shape Sprint Goals, manage work in progress, interpret flow signals and turn retrospective findings into improvement experiments.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who coordinate Agile work or are taking on responsibility for how a delivery team plans, collaborates and improves. It is designed for professionals who need practical routines for team-level delivery rather than advanced Agile transformation design.
modules: Agile Manifesto Values in Team Decisions
Scrum Guide Commitments at Team Level
Delivery Reviews and Team Improvement Plan
prerequisites: Prior Agile certification is not required. Familiarity with contributing to a team or coordinating work will help you apply the exercises to a realistic team setting.
